## Story DD Coverage
- dd-2: scalars status, type — bidirectional create/edit (delete N/A)

## Testing Mode
RED

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] Unit tests pass (exit 0)
  Verify: pytest -xvs tests/unit/dso_reconciler/test_conflict_resolver_provenance.py
- [ ] Lint passes (exit 0)
  Verify: make lint-ruff
- [ ] Format check passes (exit 0)
  Verify: make format-check
- [ ] FIELD_CLASSES contains 'title' and 'type' both with value 'state'
  Verify: pytest -xvs tests/unit/dso_reconciler/test_conflict_resolver_provenance.py::test_field_classes_includes_title_and_type
- [ ] resolve_field with ledger=None preserves prior behavior (no ledger calls, no exceptions)
  Verify: pytest -xvs tests/unit/dso_reconciler/test_conflict_resolver_provenance.py::test_resolve_field_backward_compatible_no_ledger
- [ ] resolve_field records ledger entries per element with side+timestamp across all 6 scalars (title, description, status, priority, type, assignee) and 4 collections (comments, labels, watchers, links)
  Verify: pytest -xvs tests/unit/dso_reconciler/test_conflict_resolver_provenance.py::test_resolve_field_records_provenance_all_element_classes
- [ ] Coexistence: resolve_set_valued continues to populate the existing provenance_record FIFO list AND also records to the new ledger when provided; both coexist without interaction
  Verify: pytest -xvs tests/unit/dso_reconciler/test_conflict_resolver_provenance.py::test_set_strategy_populates_both_provenance_record_and_ledger
- [ ] All 5 existing conflict_resolver / differ test files pass without edits (regression gate)
  Verify: pytest -xvs tests/unit/dso_reconciler/test_conflict_resolver.py tests/unit/dso_reconciler/test_conflict_resolver_cap.py tests/unit/dso_reconciler/test_conflict_resolver_divergence.py tests/unit/dso_reconciler/test_conflict_resolver_fitness.py tests/unit/dso_reconciler/test_differ_conflict_resolution.py

## Implementation Notes
Modify plugins/dso/scripts/dso_reconciler/conflict_resolver.py:
- Add 'title': 'state' and 'type': 'state' to FIELD_CLASSES (lines 19-28). Preserve dict-of-strings shape — applier.py:585-589 depends on FIELD_CLASSES.get(...) == 'set'.
- Add ledger: ProvenanceLedger | None = None kwarg to resolve_field (line 106). When ledger is not None, after each resolution call ledger.record(element_class=field_name, element_id=<id>, side=<winning_side>, timestamp=<pass_ts>, content_hash=<sha256 of resolved value>).
- For scalars: one ledger.record per resolve_field call.
- For additive list / set strategies: one ledger.record per element with that element's content-hash.
- Backward-compat: existing call sites passing no ledger keep working (None default).
- DO NOT touch resolve_set_valued's existing provenance_record FIFO param (line 72) — that is independent set-level mechanism; this story adds per-element via the new ledger. Both populate independently; no double-tracking interaction.

Test file: create NEW file tests/unit/dso_reconciler/test_conflict_resolver_provenance.py (T4 will create a SEPARATE file test_conflict_resolver_provenance_matrix.py — do NOT extend this file in T4).

## Retry Budget
MAX_ATTEMPTS: 3 (sonnet model)
On 3 consecutive sonnet failures: escalate to opus with full diagnostic context (all 3 failure messages)
On 3 consecutive opus failures (6 total): escalate to user with full failure history
If MAX_AGENTS: 0 at sonnet→opus escalation time: skip opus step, escalate to user immediately
data.title: RED: extend FIELD_CLASSES with title/type + thread ledger through resolve_field
